item.text: {"case_id":"SHC003","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C21","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 plausibly supplied a concrete and material template for the child. The child closely reproduces C22's distinctive factual indictment of Iran and its four-part policy formulation, then reports the sanctions-restoration action that C22 specifically ordered. C21 and C20 are also strong antecedents for the child's historical narrative, section-by-section sanctions description, and congressional-report format, but C22 has the clearest distinctive language and immediate functional continuity.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Iran remains the world's leading state sponsor of terrorism, and provides assistance to Lebanese Hizballah, Hamas, Kata'ib Hizballah, the Taliban, al-Qa'ida, and other terrorist networks. Iran also continues to fuel sectarian tension in Iraq, and support vicious civil wars in Yemen and Syria. It commits grievous human rights abuses, and arbitrarily detains foreigners, including United States citizens, on spurious charges without due process of law.","parent_excerpt":"Iran remains the world's leading state sponsor of terrorism, and provides assistance to Hezbollah, Hamas, the Taliban, al-Qa'ida, and other terrorist networks. Iran also continues to fuel sectarian violence in Iraq, and support vicious civil wars in Yemen and Syria. It commits grievous human rights abuses, and arbitrarily detains foreigners, including United States citizens, on spurious charges without due process of law.","explanation":"This is an extensive, distinctive near-verbatim passage, with only minor additions and substitutions."},{"child_excerpt":"It is the policy of the United States that Iran be denied all paths to develop or acquire a nuclear weapon; that Iran's network and campaign of regional aggression be neutralized and constrained; to disrupt, degrade, or deny the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps and its surrogates access to the resources that sustain their destabilizing activities; and to impede Iran's aggressive development of longer-range missiles, including intercontinental ballistic missiles, and other asymmetric and conventional weapons capabilities.","parent_excerpt":"It is the policy of the United States that Iran be denied a nuclear weapon and intercontinental ballistic missiles; that Iran's network and campaign of regional aggression be neutralized; to disrupt, degrade, or deny the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps and its surrogates access to the resources that sustain their destabilizing activities; and to counter Iran's aggressive development of missiles and other asymmetric and conventional weapons capabilities.","explanation":"The child preserves C22's distinctive four-part policy sequence and much of its exact wording while expanding individual elements."},{"child_excerpt":"On May 8, 2018 ... I announced my decision to cease the participation of the United States in the JCPOA and to reimpose all sanctions lifted or waived in connection with the JCPOA.","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of State shall ... take all appropriate steps to cease the participation of the United States in the JCPOA. The Secretary of State and the Secretary of the Treasury shall immediately begin taking steps to re-impose all United States sanctions lifted or waived in connection with the JCPOA.","explanation":"The child reports implementation of the precise two-part administrative program directed by C22: withdrawal from the JCPOA and restoration of the associated sanctions."}]}
